capabilities: Build persistent graph notes from frontmatter roots and LinkType definitions
Expand nodes and embedded notes into nested graph lenses
Add relationships by dragging nodes onto LinkType badges and mutating note YAML
Style nodes with group notes, icons, and configurable colors
Export the current graph view as a PNG image
extras: Beta warning: earlier builds could empty open graph notes on reload; the README recommends backups or a copied vault. Plugin writes runtime state into graph notes and mutates relationship notes' YAML.
problem: Obsidian's built-in graph view only shows wiki-links read-only and cannot build structured, property-driven graphs or edit relationships visually from notes.

relations.evidence: Connect a graph note to one or more Obsidian Bases views through connected_base_filter
Apply a Templater template to selected graph nodes with Apply template to selected nodes when the Templater plugin is enabled

summary: Interactive graph builder that renders note relationships from frontmatter properties as expandable, persistent graph views with typed edges, lenses, and groups.
